Sali |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|National Unity Party (Philippines)}}|border=darkgray}} [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|NUP]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = Majority }} '''Tawi-Tawi's at-large congressional district''' refers to the lone [[congressional district of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Tawi-Tawi]]. The province has been represented in the country's [[List of legislatures of the Philippines|national legislatures]] since 1984.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 8, 2021}} It first elected a representative provincewide [[at-large]] during the [[1984 Philippine parliamentary election]] following the restoration of provincial and city district representation in the [[Batasang Pambansa]] where Tawi-Tawi had previously been included in the regionwide representation of [[Western Mindanao]] (Region IX) for the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa|interim parliament]].{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=660|date=March 7, 1984|url=http://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/l82d3 |title=An Act Changing the Name of the Province of North Cotabato to Cotabato. |website=Lawyerly |accessdate=March 8, 2021}} The province, created by the 1973 separation of the [[Tawi-Tawi Island|Tawi-Tawi island group]] from [[Sulu]], was formerly represented as part of [[Sulu's at-large congressional district|that province's at-large district]] in earlier legislatures.{{cite PH act|chamber=PD|number=302, s. 1973|date=September 27, 1973|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/presdecs/pd1973/pd_302_1973.html |title=Creating the Province of Tawi-Tawi|website=Arellano Law Foundation |accessdate=March 8, 2021}} Since the 1987 restoration of Congress following the ratification of a new constitution, Tawi-Tawi has been entitled to one member in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=March 8, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by Dimszar M. Sali of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 8, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Tenure of office ! rowspan="2" | Batasang
